security_claim: No demonstrated remote exploit or assigned CVE; not a complete Wi-Fi security audit.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Primary-only removal leaves secondary-owned pcim MSI action unreleased; rebind log says MSI already enabled.
confirmed_findings.repair: Explicit native-vector ledger for both devices, released by the primary after both handlers stop.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Pinned remove frees mt76 device while primary-owned devm IRQ callbacks still reference it.
confirmed_findings.repair: Mask, synchronize IRQs, drain tasklet, mask again and free handlers before DMA/device memory; never infer vector ownership from post-detach WED active state.

confirmed_findings.evidence: DMA and firmware initialize before guarded EEPROM rejection; failed registration previously only freed mt76 device.
confirmed_findings.repair: Stage-aware unregister for errors, MCU exit with service still available, NAPI/worker stop, complete resource cleanup.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Normal remove did not cancel init_work or close recovery admission; observed reset/scan warning is consistent with teardown work, but not a unique root cause proof.
confirmed_findings.repair: Removal admission gate plus reset/dump worker entry guards; cancel init/dump/reset/RRO/RC work and drain after IRQ quiescence.

confirmed_findings.evidence: get_device pins device object, not secondary devm HIF/BAR memory.
confirmed_findings.repair: Managed supplier link before HIF lookup, require CONSUMER_PROBE state, defer unavailable supplier, filter linked supplier in HIF list and lock list deletion.
Initialize RRO list heads before init failures; tolerate uncreated NAPI and clear dummy-netdev pointer after allocation failure; coredump unregister tolerates NULL.

calibration.limitation: Header/config checks are not cryptographic/full-RF-table authentication; preserve private full-file integrity gates.

vendor_comparison.live_irq_evidence: mtk_pci text relocations free_irq@0x2284 -> pci_free_irq_vectors@0x229c and @0x4584 -> @0x459c; local function names stripped.
vendor_comparison.gpl_bsp_vs_live: Function-level source corroboration only, not proven byte-identical.
vendor_comparison.post_driver_link_rates: Both measured 5 GT/s x1 by M66.

validation.optional_compile: 12 changed-unit builds across WED, NPU, WED+NPU synthetic configs passed; no optional backend qualification.
